limitations: This temperature prediction uses recent daily weather for this city. It is issued after a day is complete and uses only information available then. It is not an official forecast. Average error is checked on past days that were not used to build it. The likely range is an estimate from those past days, not a guarantee. Nothing is claimed beyond the trained 1 to 7 day range.
validation_use: Validation metrics are reported and were not used to fit or select the temperature model.
